correctness.rationale: From the Cayley steps ±(1,0), ±(0,1), ±(1,1) on Z4², independently rebuilt the 16-vertex graph with 48 edges and independence face vector (16,72,96,16). Signed simplicial boundary ranks are 57 and 16; the 16 ∂3 invariant factors are units, so reduced H2 is free Z^23. Exact Smith normal form of [∂3 | 32 oriented induced octahedra] is 1^38,2, proving full-rank index 2, while one cycle appended to ∂3 gives 17 units. Exhaustive binary H2 census of all 11,440 seven-vertex sets gives 11,120 zero and 320 one, each positive set containing exactly one six-vertex octahedron; no outside-index-two class has support ≤7. The eight-vertex set {0,1,2,4,7,9,10,11} has 8,19,14,1 faces, two actual elementary collapses to a 12-triangle sphere, and its signed cycle extends Smith factors to 39 units, hence generates the missing coset. The general six-vertex minimum for a flag H2 carrier follows by vertex-link Mayer–Vietoris: each vertex of a minimal induced support has a 4-vertex 1-cycle link; any five-vertex flag support would be a cone/simplex. The supplied orbit code also checks 192 affine automorphisms act transitively on the 32 carriers.
residual_risks: Fixed Shrikhande graph only; no all-graph generalization, and no claim of unique 8-vertex witness. Independent recomputation is exact finite algebra, not a literature-priority certificate.
